item.title: Show HN: Music Puzzle Game on Steroids
item.summary: I am a puzzle and music buff. This was vibecoded over a weekend a year ago. I just checked recently and it has blown up! If you have ever craved a sleek and new music puzzle game, here it is. It breaks down a song into different stems for you to guess a dn a clever signal processing thing to turn the vocals into humming - something I built Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49447840 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
